id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point links between GPUs (and GPU-CPU, die-to-die). Each GPU has multiple NVLinks that connect directly to peer GPUs (small mesh / hybrid-cube-mesh) or to an NVLink Switch (NVSwitch) that builds an all-to-all fabric. NVLink-C2C connects dies/chips on a package cache-coherently (Grace-Hopper).

supported_topologies.name: Point-to-point GPU<->GPU
supported_topologies.description: A direct NVLink between two GPUs; full per-link bandwidth.

supported_topologies.name: Small GPU mesh / hybrid-cube-mesh
supported_topologies.description: Each GPU uses its few NVLinks to connect to several neighbors (e.g. 4-8 GPU nodes).

supported_topologies.name: NVSwitch all-to-all fabric
supported_topologies.description: GPUs connect to NVLink Switch chips; every GPU reaches every other GPU at full NVLink bandwidth (DGX/HGX 8/16 GPUs).

supported_topologies.name: GPU<->CPU coherent attach
supported_topologies.description: Coherent NVLink to a CPU (V100<->POWER9; Grace<->Hopper via C2C).

supported_topologies.name: NVLink-C2C die-to-die
supported_topologies.description: Cache-coherent chip-to-chip coupling on a package (Grace-Hopper superchip).

supported_topologies.name: NVLink Switch System (rack-scale)
supported_topologies.description: Multi-node fabric extending NVLink across a rack of GPUs.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Originates and services read/write/atomic transactions; has multiple NVLinks (4/6/12/18 by generation).
Non-blocking crossbar routing NVLink traffic for all-to-all GPU connectivity; a fabric manager programs routing.
Die-to-die coherent endpoint on a package.

fields.interconnect_role: NVLink is a fabric of point-to-point links. Directly or via NVSwitch crossbars, GPUs perform peer memory read/write/atomic operations on each other's HBM at high bandwidth and low latency, complementing (not replacing) the PCIe host link. NVLink-C2C extends this die-to-die with hardware cache coherence.

ordering_guarantees.posted_write_ordering: Posted writes ordered within a virtual channel / traffic class.
ordering_guarantees.response_ordering: Reads and atomics return responses; not ordered against new requests, allowing pipelining.
ordering_guarantees.coherent_ordering: NVLink-C2C provides cache-coherent ordering between CPU and GPU.
ordering_guarantees.fabric_routing: NVSwitch routes flits between any pair of GPUs without reordering within a flow.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: NVLink primarily carries memory transactions (peer GPU HBM, CPU memory) — read/write/atomic — for GPU memory pooling and multi-GPU synchronization. NVLink-C2C adds a coherent shared-memory view between dies.

device_classification.nvswitch: NVLink Switch crossbar for all-to-all fabrics.
